description: This PHP class defines a model for managing stock status records in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve stock status data from the database, handling localization and caching considerations.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing stock status entries in the database, supporting CRUD operations, localization, and caching.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Creates a new stock status record in the database, supporting multiple languages, and clears the cache.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing stock status record by deleting the old one and adding new descriptions, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Deletes a stock status record by its ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status record by its ID considering the current language.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stock status records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Counts the total number of stock status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description record for a stock status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all stock status descriptions associated with a particular language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific stock status description for a given stock status ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns all descriptions for a specific stock status ID, grouped by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all stock status descriptions associated with a particular language ID.
